answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade: the stake is slashed on proven abuse, so each fake identity costs real money instead of being free. Cap the identities one stake can spawn, and stretch verification over a long horizon, like timber seasoning: identities gain trust only after weeks of honest work. A Sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes, wait out the horizon, and still lose the deposit when caught, which makes the attack cost more than any profit it could extract.
